# bloxone_cdc_source_nios_list (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing NIOS Sources.

The NIOS Source object represents a NIOS instance configured as a data source for Cloud Data Connector (CDC).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get CDC NIOS Sources filtered by name
data "bloxone_cdc_source_nios_list" "example_by_name" {
  filters = {
    name = "example_cdc_source_nios_basic"
  }
}

# Get CDC NIOS Sources filtered by address
data "bloxone_cdc_source_nios_list" "example_by_address" {
  filters = {
    address = "10.1.0.0"
  }
}

# Get CDC NIOS Sources filtered by tag
# Note: tag_filters is currently ignored by the CDC backend for NIOS sources, so all sources are returned.
data "bloxone_cdc_source_nios_list" "example_by_tag" {
  tag_filters = {
    site = "Site A"
  }
}

# Get all CDC NIOS Sources
data "bloxone_cdc_source_nios_list" "example_all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes, e.g. name. If you specify multiple filters, the results returned will have only resources that match all the specified filters.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Tag Filters are used to return a more specific list of results filtered by tags. If you specify multiple filters, the results returned will have only resources that match all the specified filters.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) The list of NIOS Sources matching the specified filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Required:

- `address` (String) The IP address or FQDN of the NIOS Grid Master. Must be unique across NIOS sources.
- `name` (String) The name of the NIOS source. Must be unique across NIOS sources.

Optional:

- `ca_certificate` (String, Sensitive) The PEM-encoded CA certificate used to verify the NIOS Grid Master ("CA Certificate" in the UI). This value is not returned by the API.
- `certificate` (String, Sensitive) The PEM-encoded certificate for RPZ logs ("Certificate for RPZ Logs" in the UI). This value is not returned by the API.
- `description` (String) The description of the NIOS source.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the NIOS source is enabled. Defaults to `false`.
- `insecure_mode` (Boolean) Indicates whether to skip TLS certificate verification when connecting to the NIOS Grid Master.
- `nios_password` (String, Sensitive) The password of the NIOS user. This value is not returned by the API.
- `nios_username` (String) The username used to connect to the NIOS Grid Master.
- `rpz_log_insecure_mode` (Boolean) Indicates whether to skip TLS certificate verification when collecting RPZ logs. Defaults to `false`.
- `scp_password` (String, Sensitive) The password of the SCP user. This value is not returned by the API.
- `scp_username` (String) The username used for SCP transfer of DNS query logs from NIOS.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the NIOS source.

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Time when the object has been created.
- `id` (Number) The resource identifier.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) The tags for the NIOS source, including default tags.
- `updated_at` (String) Time when the object has been updated. Equals to _created_at_ if not updated after creation.
